<nav class="crumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb"><div class="wrap"><ol><li><a href="/">Home</a><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-chev-right"></use></svg></li><li><a href="/blogs/">Drain Advice</a><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-chev-right"></use></svg></li><li><span aria-current="page">Can You Prevent Blocked Shower Drains With A Drain Guard?</span></li></ol></div></nav><section class="arthero"><div class="wrap"><span class="eyebrow">Prevention and upkeep</span><h1>Can You Prevent Blocked Shower Drains With A Drain Guard?</h1><div class="artmeta"><span><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-calendar"></use></svg> Published 18 March 2024</span><span><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-rotate"></use></svg> Updated 26 June 2026</span><span><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-clock"></use></svg> 5 min read</span></div></div></section><section class="section s-white artsec"><div class="wrap"><div class="artwrap"><div class="artbody"><p>Ever stepped out of the shower to find yourself wading in a puddle of your own making? A <b>blocked shower drain</b> can be a frustrating and unpleasant experience. Hair, soap scum, and other debris can accumulate over time, creating a blockage that disrupts water flow and potentially leads to <b>foul odours</b>. But fear not, there are ways to fight back against the dreaded blocked shower drain!</p><figure class="artlead"><img src="/uploads/can-you-prevent-blocked-shower-drains-with-a-drain-guard.jpg" width="1000" height="667" alt="Can You Prevent Blocked Shower Drains With A Drain Guard?" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" sizes="(max-width:1024px) 100vw, 610px"></figure><h2 id="s-what-is-a-shower-drain-guard">What is a shower drain guard?</h2><p>A <b>shower drain guard</b> is a simple yet effective tool designed to prevent debris from entering your drain. Typically made from plastic or silicone, these guards sit snugly over the drain opening and act as a physical barrier. There are various types available, including mesh guards that trap hair and larger particles, and flat silicone guards with small perforations that allow water to pass through while catching hair.</p><h2 id="s-why-do-shower-drains-get-blocked">Why do shower drains get blocked?</h2><p>The most common culprits behind blocked shower drains are the very things we use while showering: hair, soap scum, and dead skin cells.</p><figure class="artfig"><img src="/uploads/why-do-shower-drains-get-blocked.jpg" width="1000" height="667" alt="A hand lifting a clump of hair out of a square chrome floor waste grate" loading="lazy" decoding="async" sizes="(max-width:1024px) 100vw, 610px"></figure><p>Hair, in particular, is a notorious drain clogger. It can clump together and form a formidable mass that traps other debris, eventually leading to a blockage. Soap scum, a combination of soap residue, minerals from hard water, and body oils, can also contribute to the problem by creating a sticky film that attracts and binds hair and other materials.</p><h2 id="s-how-does-a-drain-guard-prevent-blocked-shower-dr">How does a drain guard prevent blocked shower drains?</h2><p>Think of your drain guard as a bouncer for your shower drain. It stands guard at the entrance, preventing the biggest troublemakers (hair) from entering the pipes. By catching hair and other large debris before they have a chance to make their way deeper into the drain system, a drain guard significantly reduces the risk of a blockage forming.</p><aside class="artmid" aria-label="Talk to a drainer"><span class="am-ic"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-phone-volume"></use></svg></span><span class="am-t"><b>Reading this because a drain is playing up?</b><p>Tell us what it is doing and we will tell you what it takes to fix it. $0 call-out fee.</p></span><span class="am-go"><a class="btn btn-red" href="tel:0289600868"><svg class="ico ico-phone" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-phone"></use></svg> Call (02) 8960 0868</a><button class="btn btn-outline" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="quickquote"><svg class="ico" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-file-lines"></use></svg> Quick Quote</button></span></aside><h2 id="s-can-drain-guards-completely-eliminate-clogs">Can drain guards completely eliminate clogs?</h2><p>While drain guards are excellent at preventing the main culprits of blocked shower drains, it’s important to remember they’re <b>not foolproof</b>. Smaller particles like soap scum can still slip through the mesh or perforations. Additionally, a full drain guard <b>can overflow with hair</b>, creating a blockage on top of the guard itself. This is why it’s crucial to maintain your drain guard by <b>regularly cleaning</b> it to remove accumulated debris.</p><figure class="artfig"><img src="/uploads/can-drain-guards-completely-eliminate-clogs.jpg" width="1000" height="667" alt="Liquid drain cleaner being poured from a bottle into a shower floor waste" loading="lazy" decoding="async" sizes="(max-width:1024px) 100vw, 610px"></figure><p>Even with a drain guard in place, there’s a chance you may encounter a blockage at some point. If this happens, there are several <a href="/what-is-the-best-way-to-unclog-a-drain/">methods available to unclog your drain</a>. However, for the best way to unclog a drain and avoid causing further damage, it’s always recommended to consult a professional plumber. They have the expertise and tools to safely and effectively remove any blockages.</p><h2 id="s-what-are-the-benefits-of-using-a-drain-guard">What are the benefits of using a drain guard?</h2><p>The benefits of using a drain guard extend far beyond simply preventing a blocked shower drain. Here are some key advantages:</p><ul><li><b>Reduced risk of flooding:</b> A blocked drain can lead to water overflowing from the shower pan, potentially causing damage to your bathroom floor and surrounding areas. A drain guard minimises this risk by keeping the drain clear and allowing water to flow freely.</li><li><b>Prevents bad odours:</b> Blocked drains are notorious for breeding unpleasant odours. The stagnant water and trapped organic matter create a breeding ground for bacteria, which can lead to foul smells emanating from your shower. A drain guard helps prevent this by keeping the drain free-flowing and reducing the build-up of organic material.</li><li><b>Saves you money:</b> Blocked drains can be a costly problem. Recurring blockages can drain your wallet (pun intended). A drain guard, on the other hand, is a relatively inexpensive investment that can save you money in the long run.</li><li><b>Mitigates the risks of neglecting blocked drains:</b> By preventing blockages in the first place, a drain guard helps you avoid the <a href="https://www.homeone.com.au/articles/pipe_cable_inspection/8_risks_of_neglecting_blocked_drains" rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank">potential consequences of neglecting a clogged drain</a>. These risks can include water damage to your bathroom, mould growth due to moisture build-up, and even health hazards associated with stagnant water and bacteria.</li></ul><h2 id="s-how-do-you-choose-the-right-drain-guard">How do you choose the right drain guard?</h2><p>Choosing the right drain guard for your shower is simple. Here are a few factors to consider:</p><ul><li><b>Size:</b> Make sure the drain guard you choose is the right size for your shower drain. It should fit snugly over the drain opening without being too loose or too tight.</li><li><b>Material:</b> Mesh guards are effective at catching hair, while silicone guards offer a more discreet option. Consider your priorities and preferences when selecting a material.</li><li><b>Ease of Cleaning:</b> A drain guard that’s easy to clean will help you maintain its effectiveness. Look for guards with a simple design that allows for easy removal and cleaning of debris.</li></ul><h2 id="s-how-do-you-maintain-your-drain-guard-for-optimal">How do you maintain your drain guard for optimal performance?</h2><p>To ensure your drain guard performs at its best, it’s essential to clean it regularly. The frequency of cleaning will depend on how much hair you shed and how often you shower. However, as a general rule, it’s recommended to clean your drain guard at least once a week. Simply remove the guard from the drain, dispose of any accumulated debris, and rinse it with warm water.</p><h3>Conclusion: Are drain guards worth it?</h3><p>Drain guards are a simple and effective way to prevent blocked shower drains. They offer a range of benefits, from preventing <b>messy clogs</b> and foul odours to saving you money on professional drain cleaning services. While they may not completely eliminate the possibility of a blockage, they significantly reduce the risk and make maintenance much easier.</p><p>Considering the low cost and the potential to save yourself a major headache (and potentially a <b>flooded bathroom</b>!), drain guards are a worthwhile investment for any shower.</p><h3>Take control of your shower drain with Sydney Blocked Drain Service!</h3><p>Fed up with the constant battle against blocked shower drains? Not exactly the picture of post-shower bliss, right? <span>If you’re addressing blocked shower drains, it might also be beneficial to understand the <a href="https://proleakwaterproofing.com.au/8-early-warning-signs-your-bathroom-waterproofing-is-failing-before-tiles-start-lifting/" rel="nofollow noopener" target="_blank">warning signs of failing bathroom waterproofing</a> to prevent further issues.</span></p><p>Sydney Blocked Drain Service is <a href="/services/high-pressure-water-jetter/">here to help you ditch the shower clogs for good</a>! We offer a comprehensive range of <b>drain cleaning solutions</b>, from tackling stubborn blockages to preventative maintenance services that keep your drains flowing freely.</p><p>Our team of licenced and experienced plumbers are not just drain cleaning experts, they’re also drain guard connoisseurs! They can help you choose the perfect drain guard for your shower size and hair type, ensuring it effectively traps debris before it creates a blockage. They’ll even take care of the installation for you, guaranteeing a proper fit that won’t compromise functionality.</p><p>Don’t wait for a major clog to bring your showering routine to a screeching halt!
